<function name="SetTextSelectionColors" parent="Panel" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets text selection colors of a <page>RichText</page> element.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<added>2023.01.25</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="textColor" type="Color">The <page>Color</page> to set for selected text.</arg>
		<arg name="backgroundColor" type="Color">The <page>Color</page> to set for selected text background.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
